subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Their teacher used the debate to discuss simulation and reality.”?
options: Students read about it and argued whether digital art could be valuable if anyone could copy the image.
A digital pet can teach routines and affection, but it cannot fully teach the needs of a living creature.
It made students notice growth, responsibility, and the quiet needs of living things.
The teacher explained that such laws try to protect rivers not only as resources for humans, but as living systems.
